title: Context bundle role manifest
description: Frontmatter contract for 5_executing/manifests/roles/<role>.md — provider-neutral role metadata following the claude-skills frontmatter taxonomy (name/description + declarative extensions). The compiler (compile-context-bundles.mjs) renders one context file per worker (context/workers/wave-N/<US-ID>.md) and per role and wave (context/roles/wave-N/<role>.md); the lead names that file's path in the spawn prompt. No hook delivers context. The source-id -> path map and the hard never-inject list (whole PRDs, other stories' wave plans, progress.md, SKILL.md texts, src/**/agent.md) live in the compiler, not here: a manifest can only pick from the closed `inject` vocabulary below.

name.description: Role id, unique across manifests, e.g. frontend-implementer

description.description: When this role is spawned (claude-skills style: trigger conditions, not prose)

tier.description: Spawn tier (CONCEPT.md §5): 0 = micro-fix, inject NOTHING; 1 = story implementer, full type-scoped pack; 2 = reviewer/QA persona, minimal pack. Explore-type roles are modeled as tier 2 with inject: [].

scope.description: Which side of the type-scoped injection matrix applies

inject.description: Ordered source ids compiled into the role's worker and role files. Empty array = no file is compiled (tier 0, explore). `architecture-delta` is the legacy alias of `proj-architecture`.

budget_tokens.description: Hard token budget for the compiled bundle (heuristic ceil(chars/4)); compile fails and writes nothing on breach

matcher.description: Regex (unanchored, case-insensitive) matched against the spawned subagent type (role identification; only the retired context-injector.mjs stub still reads it)

claude.description: Claude agent file: how this role lands in .claude/agents/skillchain-<name>.md (roles with an inject list tell the agent to read the file whose path the spawn prompt names, and to abort without one)

agent_file.description: Write a .claude/agents/skillchain-<name>.md agent file (compile rewrites it on every run)

tools.description: Comma-separated tool allowlist for the agent file

codex.description: Codex delivery: the lane prompt names the worker file path

delivery.description: Codex lanes read the file whose path the lane prompt names (specs/.../context/workers/wave-N/<US-ID>.md, or context/roles/wave-N/<role>.md without a story) before implementing

sandbox.description: Codex sandbox mode the role runs under, e.g. workspace-write / read-only
